weeks.title: Record demand
weeks.note: ERCOT's all-time demand record on Wednesday, then a tight evening as solar faded.
weeks.example: Tell me when ERCOT is actually heading toward scarcity, not just setting demand records.

weeks.title: Heat wave
weeks.note: Demand near 90 GW every day; reserve prices spiked on the 22nd, 23rd and 26th.
weeks.example: Warn me when the grid is running short of reserves, not just when it's hot.

weeks.title: Winter price spikes
weeks.note: Prices passed $300 on five days, mostly with reserves to spare; on the 28th they hit $1,350 as reserves fell to 5.7 GW.
weeks.example: Tell me when a price spike comes with reserves running low.

weeks.title: Negative prices
weeks.note: Strong wind held the hub price below zero for 25 hours, nine of them on the 24th.
weeks.example: Let me know when there's so much wind and solar that prices go negative.

weeks.title: Low wind
weeks.note: Wind averaged under 6 GW on five days; prices and reserve prices jumped on the 5th and 7th.
weeks.example: Warn me when weak wind is leaving the grid tight in the evening.
